creature_families: 15 monster classnames declared in qw-qc/server.qc 28-42 as remove-on-spawn stubs (names only): ogre, demon, shambler, knight, army, wizard, dog, zombie, boss, tarbaby, hell knight, fish, shalrath, enforcer, oldone
No monster AI, models, tiers or abilities in the box (data pack and single-player progs absent)
classes: None. One player model and one class (qw-qc/player.qc). No races or factions; teamplay is a friendly-fire setting in qw-qc/combat.qc
weapon_families: Axe (melee, no ammo, 0.5 s cooldown, four random swing frames) - qw-qc/weapons.qc 1023-1091
Shotgun and super shotgun (6 and 14 pellets, batched into one damage call per target) - qw-qc/weapons.qc 185-258, 290-373
Nailgun and super nailgun (spike damage 9 and 18) - qw-qc/weapons.qc 822, 869; cadence not read
Grenade launcher (bounce then detonate, 120 radius) - qw-qc/weapons.qc 618-655
Rocket launcher (speed 1000, 5 s self-remove, 120 radius) - qw-qc/weapons.qc 422, 444-483
Lightning gun (30 per trace per tick, three traces, 0.1 s cooldown, underwater explosion) - qw-qc/weapons.qc 485-616
Auto-switch order (lightning, super nailgun, super shotgun, nailgun, shotgun, axe; rockets commented out) - qw-qc/weapons.qc 963-989
gear_tiers: Armour red: absorbs 80 percent, pool 200 (qw-qc/items.qc 395-453); the three tiers share one model and differ by skin (items.qc 454-487)
Invulnerability artifact: 30 s, respawn 5 min, effect-flag glow (qw-qc/items.qc 1311-1400)
Environment suit artifact: 30 s, respawn 60 s (qw-qc/items.qc 1404-1420)
Quad damage artifact: 30 s, 4x damage, blue glow, respawn 60 s (qw-qc/items.qc 1443-1470; combat.qc 152-156 multiplier)
zones: No maps in the box. Entity vocabulary only (80 QUAKED headers in qw-qc)
Water: drowning after 12 s of air, damage ramp (qw-qc/client.qc 800-830)
Slime: 4 per water level per second (qw-qc/client.qc 854-860)
Lava: 10 per water level every 0.2 s, radiation suit slows it (qw-qc/client.qc 842-852)
Traps: trap_shooter and trap_spikeshooter with a laser variant (qw-qc/misc.qc 380-449)
Lava balls: misc_fireball on a random 3-8 s clock (qw-qc/misc.qc 191-226)
Gated progress: sigils, gold and silver keys, episode gates, boss gate (qw-qc/misc.qc 623-650; items.qc 1166-1270)

looks.label: Flag-driven glow with dim light
looks.technique: Effect flags set on the player entity while the buff runs, cleared on expiry (EF_BLUE, EF_RED plus EF_DIMLIGHT)

looks.label: Accelerating particle burst
looks.technique: Fixed particle pool, 8-step palette ramp advanced by frame time, velocity multiplied by a per-second factor so the burst accelerates outward

looks.label: Blob explosion with two particle types
looks.technique: 1024 particles split between two types, life 1.0 to 1.4 s

looks.label: Teleport splash grid
looks.technique: Grid of about 896 short-lived particles pushed radially from the centre

looks.label: Three-trace beam width
looks.technique: Three parallel traces offset perpendicular to the beam; the offset formula is buggy (see defects)

looks.label: Visible-only blood event
looks.technique: Temp-entity message multicast to clients that can see the spot

looks.label: Power-up warning flash
looks.technique: Last 3 s of quad: screen flash and sound once per second

originals.name: Carry-the-clock buff
originals.idea: A buff dropped on death keeps the time it had left and vanishes when that time ends.
originals.keep: Carried timer and the matching despawn (qw-qc/items.qc 99-122; player.qc 580-600)
originals.change: The drop is a glowing shard that shows its countdown and sits on the ground instead of tossing

originals.name: Effective-strength gear swap
originals.idea: New armour replaces the old only when its absorb fraction times pool is higher.
originals.keep: The compare (qw-qc/items.qc 428) and the fraction-times-pool absorb (combat.qc 160-175)
originals.change: Three plate types with their own silhouettes, not green, yellow and red

originals.name: Three-strand arc gun
originals.idea: Three parallel traces give a beam its width.
originals.keep: The three-trace width trick (weapons.qc 502-543) with the offset fixed
originals.change: A branching arc that jumps to a second target, with a crackle sound

originals.name: Pellet bundle
originals.idea: Multi-pellet damage sums into one damage call per target.
originals.change: A double-barrel spread pattern and the per-target flush fixed

originals.name: Ember burst
originals.idea: Explosion from a colour ramp that accelerates outward, timed in seconds not frames.
originals.change: Our own palette and a shockwave ring

originals.name: Drowning clock
originals.idea: A breath counter, then rising damage that caps.
originals.change: The cap instead of the reset to 10 at 16

originals.name: Lava lob
originals.idea: A vent throws a timed arc on a random 3 to 8 second clock.
originals.change: A fixed launch speed (the source never sets it) and a visible ember trail
